integrity: Self-contained topological proof; standard Brouwer and covering dimension results used explicitly. All relevant prior constructions are credited; no independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The crossing radius is sufficient, not asserted sharp. No classification of all one-dimensional spaces or general Banach algebras is claimed; the dimensional threshold is universal, with a single dimension-one obstruction.
title: A one-dimensional compact obstruction to density of disconnected spectral classes
